releaseTitle: AdSkip Pro v1.0.32 - Landscape Ad Precision, Geometric HUD Exclusion & Phonetic OCR Shielding
releaseNotes:
* Rotated Screen (Landscape Ads) Support: Added multi-quadrant corner perception across top-left, top-right, bottom-left, and bottom-right corners when width > height
* Orientation Hash Isolation: VisualPatternCache isolates portrait dHashes from landscape frames to prevent mismatched layout taps
* Phonetic OCR Shielding: Expanded HUD overlay regex with 'slalus', 'slelus', and phonetic variants to neutralize OCR misreadings of 'Status:'
* Hard Geometric Exclusion: Blocked clicks in dead center (x: 250..750, y: 100..750) during active ad countdowns
* Smart Dual-Corner Probing: Dynamic top-right probing at scan 12 and top-left probing at scan 15 adapting dynamically to screen orientation
